d:
The Celtics defeated the 76ers, 123-101 tonight in Philadelphia. Paul George contributed a team-high 36 points to go with 6 three pointers and 5 rebounds, with Jayson Tatum of the Celtics adding an additional 21 points (8-17 FG, 3-7 3P) in the game. Tyrese Maxey finished with a team-high 24 points along with 4 assists for the 76ers in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 9-2 with the win, while the 76ers fall to 9-3 for the season.
